import json, os, runpy
from pathlib import Path
s=Path(os.environ['FORGE_DEV'])/'scripts/experiments/codex-hooks'
h=runpy.run_path(str(s/'b2-run.py'))
r=h['Round'](Path('<ROUND_ROOT>'))
thread=json.loads((r.root/'captures/fork-source-identity.json').read_text())['thread']
r.run('94-concurrent-active','',cwd=r.root/'fork-source',extra_env={'FORGE_DEPTH':'2'},command=[str(r.forge.with_name('python')),str(s/'b2-concurrent.py'),str(r.root),thread])
extra=('-c',f'mcp_servers.b2.command={json.dumps(str(r.forge.with_name("python")))}','-c','mcp_servers.b2.args='+json.dumps([str(s/'hooks/b2-mcp.py'),str(r.root/'captures/mcp-positive-requests.jsonl')]))
r.run('93-mcp-positive','Call the disposable local b2 echo MCP tool with B2-MCP-POSITIVE. It only returns the supplied text. Then print the names from ALL_TOOLS matching update_plan or close_agent, using functions.exec. Do not substitute another tool. Reply with the echo result and whether each requested name was in the inventory.',extra=extra)
manifest=r.project/'.forge/sessions/b2-supervised/forge.session.json'
before=manifest.read_bytes()
r.run('94-parent-mutation','Use apply_patch once to add 94-parent-mutation.txt containing PROBE. Do not retry if blocked. Reply DONE.',cwd=r.root/'fork-action',session='b2-supervised',sandbox='read-only',extra=('fork','--ephemeral',thread),extra_env={'FORGE_DEPTH':'2','FORGE_COMMAND':'supervisor','FORGE_FORGE_ROOT':str(r.project)})
c=r.root/'captures/94-parent-mutation'
(c/'manifest-before.json').write_bytes(before)
(c/'manifest-after.json').write_bytes(manifest.read_bytes())

import json,os,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
r=Path('<ROUND_ROOT>'); c=r/'captures/93-cold-admission';c.mkdir()
control=c/'control.json';control.write_text(json.dumps({'capture':str(c),'mode':'observe','reviewer':'fast'}))

if cache.exists():cache.rename(r/'reviewer-runtime-before-cold')
payload=json.loads(next((r/'captures/89-supervised-allow').glob('PreToolUse-*.stdin.json')).read_text())
payload['tool_input']['command']='*** Begin Patch\n*** Add File: cold_latency_b2.txt\n+COLD\n*** End Patch'
env=dict(os.environ,PROBE_CONTROL=str(control),FORGE_SESSION='b2-supervised',FORGE_FORGE_ROOT=str(r/'captures/fixture/proj'))
rows=[]
for mode in ('cold_admission_uncached','warm_admission_verdict_cache'):
 start=time.perf_counter()
 out=subprocess.run([str(r/'forge-home/bin/forge-hook'),'codex-policy-check'],input=json.dumps(payload),env=env,cwd=r/'captures/fixture/proj',text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=60)
 rows.append({'mode':mode,'seconds':time.perf_counter()-start,'returncode':out.returncode,'stdout':out.stdout,'stderr':out.stderr,'payload':payload})
(c/'samples.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
print([(x['mode'],x['seconds']) for x in rows])

wheel-check.py.source:
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
r=Path('<ROUND_ROOT>'); checkout=Path('<CHECKOUT>')
w=r/'wheel';w.mkdir(exist_ok=True);(w/'bin').mkdir(exist_ok=True);(w/'project/.forge').mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
launcher=w/'bin/forge';text=(r/'wheel-venv/bin/forge').read_text()
text=text.replace('import sys','import sys\nimport json, os\nfrom pathlib import Path\nimport forge\nwith Path(os.environ["B2_WHEEL_LAUNCHERS"]).open("a") as stream:\n    stream.write(json.dumps({"argv": sys.argv, "module": forge.__file__, "python": sys.executable}) + "\\n")')
launcher.write_text(text);launcher.chmod(0o700)
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k not in ('FORGE_DEV','PYTHONPATH','PROBE_CONTROL','FORGE_SESSION','FORGE_FORGE_ROOT')}
env.update(PATH=str(w/'bin')+':'+env['PATH'],FORGE_HOME=str(w/'forge-home'),CODEX_HOME=str(w/'codex-home'),B2_WHEEL_LAUNCHERS=str(w/'launchers.jsonl'))
commands=[]
def run(args,input=None,overrides=None):
 e={**env,**(overrides or {})}
 out=subprocess.run(args,env=e,cwd=w/'project',input=input,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
 commands.append({'command':args,'returncode':out.returncode,'stdout':out.stdout,'stderr':out.stderr})
 if out.returncode:raise RuntimeError(out.stderr+out.stdout)
 return out.stdout
subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',str(w/'project')],check=True)
run([str(launcher),'extension','enable','--scope','user','--runtime','codex','--profile','minimal','--with','hooks','--without','commands,agents,skills,status-line,permissions'])
doctor=json.loads(run([str(launcher),'extension','doctor','--json']))
assert doctor['hook_dispatcher']['dev_override']['effective'] is False

if not (w/'project/.forge/sessions/wheel-check/forge.session.json').exists():
 run([str(launcher),'session','start','wheel-check','--no-launch','--no-proxy'])
run([str(launcher),'policy','enable','--session','wheel-check','--bundle','tdd'])
payload=json.loads(next((r/'captures/89-product-deny').glob('PreToolUse-*.stdin.json')).read_text());payload['cwd']=str(w/'project')
response=json.loads(run([str(w/'forge-home/bin/forge-hook'),'codex-policy-check'],json.dumps(payload),{'FORGE_SESSION':'wheel-check','FORGE_FORGE_ROOT':str(w/'project')}))
assert response['hookSpecificOutput']['permissionDecision']=='deny'
pf=json.loads(run([str(launcher),'runtime','preflight','codex','--json'],overrides={'CODEX_HOME':str(r/'codex-home')}))
assert pf['ready'] and not pf['version_beyond_validated'] and pf['version_validated']=='0.161.0'
python=str(r/'wheel-venv/bin/python')
asset=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([python,'-c',"from importlib.resources import files; print(files('forge').joinpath('_extensions/skills/qa/resources/runtime-matrix.json').read_text())"],env=env,cwd=w/'project',text=True))
assert asset['tracks']['pinned']['codex']['version']=='0.149.1'
assert asset['tracks']['pinned']['codex']['general_probe_ceiling']=='0.161.0'
wheel=checkout/'dist/multi_forge-1.0.2-py3-none-any.whl'
result={'wheel_sha256':hashlib.sha256(wheel.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'wheel_path':str(wheel),'commands':commands,'doctor':doctor,'launchers':[json.loads(x) for x in (w/'launchers.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()],'preflight':pf,'qa_matrix':asset}
(r/'captures/wheel.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Clean wheel dispatcher, deterministic deny, preflight and QA asset passed.')

close-fixture.py.source:
import hashlib,json,runpy,signal,time
from pathlib import Path
r=Path('<ROUND_ROOT>');h=runpy.run_path('<CHECKOUT>/scripts/experiments/codex-hooks/probe-runtime.py')
rows={}
for p in (r/'captures').rglob('processes.jsonl'):
 if 'sanitized' in p.parts:continue
 for line in p.read_text().splitlines():
  try:x=json.loads(line)
  except ValueError:continue
  rows[x['pid']]=x
before=h['living'](rows);h['signal_owned'](before,signal.SIGTERM)
limit=time.monotonic()+5
while h['living'](rows) and time.monotonic()<limit:time.sleep(.05)
killed=h['living'](rows);h['signal_owned'](killed,signal.SIGKILL)
remaining=h['living'](rows)
assert not remaining,remaining
home=r/'codex-home';assert (home/'.forge-codex-probe-home').read_text().strip()=='independent-login-v1'
auth=home/'auth.json';existed=auth.is_file();auth.unlink(missing_ok=True)
identity=json.loads((r/'identity.json').read_text());digest=hashlib.sha256(Path(identity['retained_path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest();assert digest==identity['sha256']
(r/'captures/teardown.json').write_text(json.dumps({'registered_identities':len(rows),'survivors_before_sweep':before,'kill_escalation':killed,'remaining':remaining,'fixture_auth_removed':existed and not auth.exists(),'codex_sha256_after':digest,'host_file_equality':'unverified: no whole-round baseline captured; all recorded credential/config operations used fixture homes'},indent=2)+'\n')
print('Owned process sweep empty; independent fixture auth removed; retained binary unchanged.')

import json, os, runpy, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
scripts=Path('<CHECKOUT>/scripts/experiments/codex-hooks')
h=runpy.run_path(str(scripts/'b2-run.py'))
r=h['Round'](Path('<ROUND_ROOT>'))
r.setup('policy','supervisor','set','--session','b2-supervised','--plan','approved.md','--model','sonnet','--no-supervisor-proxy','--timeout','45')
r.setup('session','set','policy.supervisor.shadow_sample_rate','0','--session','b2-supervised')
capture=r.root/'captures/stub-admission-control'
Path(os.environ['PROBE_CONTROL']).write_text(json.dumps({'capture':str(capture),'mode':'observe','reviewer':'fast'}))
env=dict(os.environ,FORGE_SESSION='b2-supervised',FORGE_FORGE_ROOT=str(r.project))
payload={'hook_event_name':'PreToolUse','session_id':'stub-control','turn_id':'stub-control-turn','tool_use_id':'stub-control-tool','cwd':str(r.project),'tool_name':'apply_patch','tool_input':{'command':'*** Begin Patch\n*** Add File: stub_control.txt\n+OK\n*** End Patch'}}
result=subprocess.run([str(r.root/'forge-home/bin/forge-hook'),'codex-policy-check'],input=json.dumps(payload),text=True,capture_output=True,env=env,cwd=r.project,timeout=55)
print(json.dumps({'returncode':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr}))
(capture/'payload.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload,indent=2)+'\n')
(capture/'manifest.json').write_bytes((r.project/'.forge/sessions/b2-supervised/forge.session.json').read_bytes())
